Solid navy border denotes a component owned and fully specified by the engineering team; other nodes are platform-standard or boundary systems.
1. The Lexicon Compilation Service publishes a manifest.json sidecar
alongside every .hdb file — required because Hyperscan's
expression id is numeric only; the Scanner resolves human-
readable term identity from this manifest at scan time.

3. Noise-reduction features are always evaluated before standard
features; an OR/AND matrix decides whether standard features
are skipped entirely for a given message.
